meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让输出适配ADHD读者，突出行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更清晰易读，尤其是注意力不易集中时。
copy.tagline_en: Tailor output for ADHD readers: highlight next actions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses that are easier to follow, especially when you have attention difficulties.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 的输出会改为：第一行直接给可执行的动作；多步骤任务编号列出；每一轮回复都重提进度；不扯无关话题；给具体时间估计；用平实语气描述错误；结尾不再客套寒暄。
howto.when: 当你输入 /i-have-adhd 时激活；之后持续生效，直到你说 “stop adhd mode” 才退出。

say.text: 请用 ADHD 友好的方式回答，第一步先说我现在该做什么。
say.note: Claude 会以可执行动作开头。

say.text: 把后面的步骤编号，并在每一步后面加上时间估计。
say.note: 多步任务会被拆成编号清单并附时长。

say.text: 每轮回复都告诉我现在做到第几步了。
say.note: Claude 会跨轮次重申进度。

howto.what_en: For ADHD readers, Claude leads with the next action, numbers steps, restates progress, avoids tangents, gives time estimates, states errors plainly, and drops greetings/closers.
howto.when_en: Activates when you type "/i-have-adhd"; stays active until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: Answer in ADHD-friendly style: start with the single next action I should take.
say_en.note: Claude will open with something doable.

say_en.text: Number the upcoming steps and give a time estimate for each.
say_en.note: Multi-step tasks become a numbered list with durations.

say_en.text: In each reply, tell me which step we are on now.
